claims: Fox officially renewed "Memory of a Killer" for a second season.
The second season of "Memory of a Killer" is set for the 2026-2027 season.
"Memory of a Killer" stars Patrick Dempsey as a contract killer with Alzheimer’s.
"Memory of a Killer" is a co-production between Fox and Warner Bros. Television.
New episodes of "Memory of a Killer" stream on Hulu.
In the first season finale of "Memory of a Killer", Angelo’s daughter Maria confronted Angelo about his crimes.
In the first season finale of "Memory of a Killer", Angelo's ally Dutch faced a strained relationship with Angelo.
Michael Imperioli plays Dutch in "Memory of a Killer".
Patrick Dempsey and Michael Imperioli are set to return for the second season of "Memory of a Killer".
"Memory of a Killer" is based on the 2003 Belgian film De zaak Alzheimer.
